paragraphs: Here's what I want you to carry out of this one, friend. Jesus did signs right in front of people, and many still did not believe (John 12:37). Even more surprising, many of the leaders DID believe, but they kept quiet because they loved "praise from men more than praise from God" (John 12:43). Fear of what people think can keep a believing heart quiet, and that is worth a hard look.

Now here's the good news, and it is LOUD. Jesus cries out, "I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness" (John 12:46). I spent years in the back of a drawer, so I know what that kind of light means. He also says, "I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world" (John 12:47). He came to rescue, friend.

And listen to how Jesus talks about the Father. "Whoever sees Me sees the One who sent Me" (John 12:45), and He speaks exactly what the Father told Him to say, because "His command leads to eternal life" (John 12:50). So when you open the Word, you are not getting a rumor, you are hearing the Father through the Son. Don't just hear it, friend, keep it. And if you feel the pull to stay quiet about Jesus to keep everyone happy, remember whose praise matters most.
